messages.content: The CURRENT statutes are byte-identical to an actual earlier TRAIN learned rule library. Do not regenerate the known rule functions: the runtime reuses them with their real source scopes. Return current_item_source and program_lines. Select exactly one listed CURRENT item source for the fixed item observations; their existing names, predicate meanings and shared item are instantiated by the runtime without any truth assignment. program_lines is the Python line-list representation used by PAL: one source line per string, including explicit indentation and blank lines. All listed current literal input bindings and fixed observations are already declared: read them, never redeclare or overwrite them. Generate ONLY fresh CURRENT case calculations, any selected missing rule/scope translations, and query = the native total-cost expression. Call the listed learned rule outputs as NAME() or read NAME. Their definitions, source ownership and scopes are immutable. No previous fact value, case calculation or query is reused. The earlier case application is a real syntax example, never the current answer. The passenger name is already rebound from the explicit CURRENT passenger statement, without assigning geographic truth. Factual constants use variable = literal # sN. New rule functions use @rule("sN", otherwise=EXPLICIT) and one return expression. Use actual current dimensions, weights and checked-bag positions; do not copy earlier bag categories, fares or counts. Write totals using one flat add(a, b, c, ...) call or separate named subtotals; do not nest add repeatedly. sum(NUMERIC_LIST) adds exact numeric list elements without a fixed bag count. The current query must be newly written: the previous query is omitted because its bag count and case are different. Expressions and graphs have at most16 nested operations. Every unowned source unit and proper legal residual stays unknown until actually translated. Do not mark operative headings or thresholds True, guess factual truth, or return a native answer literal. The source/type/literal/guard/resource/completion checks are unchanged. No imports, loops, tools or arbitrary calls.
